PullRequest.Title: Canvases: UI for opening Canvases from Editor Window

## Summary

- add a final **Canvas** submenu under the Editor Window's **New Chat** split button when the active initialized Chat view has applicable canvases
- keep brand-new provisional chats lazy: no canvas discovery and no Canvas submenu before the provider chat is initialized
- list registered extension canvases by their actual names, refresh them with runtime registry changes, and exclude definitions that require another input flow
- use stable instance IDs so selecting the same canvas refocuses or reopens its existing tab, while avoiding duplicate entries for registered defaults
- share canvas definition labeling, filtering, ordering, and stable-ID helpers with the Agents Window implementation
- document the submenu and keyboard navigation in Chat Accessibility Help

Related to microsoft/vscode-internalbacklog#10058.

## Actual runtime evidence

Captured from this branch through the production path:

- core `agent-host-copilotcli` session opened by the workbench
- first request sent through Agent Host using VS Code's smoke-test mock LLM transport
- project canvases registered by a real `@github/copilot-sdk/extension` provider
- menu populated through `listSessionCanvases`
- Chess opened through `openSessionCanvas` into the real canvas editor

The mock LLM only makes the model response deterministic; it does not contribute UI, menu items, chat state, or canvases.

**Before the first message:** the provisional chat has no Canvas item.

![Provisional Agent Host chat without a Canvas item](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a0df8280-77c6-4399-a6c0-4c1fb0b46c3a)

**After the real Agent Host response:** the registered canvas names appear under the final Canvas submenu.

![Initialized Agent Host chat with the Canvas submenu](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/2b231c87-cc1c-413b-ad96-cb05c7556999)

**Opening Chess:** the real canvas editor opens beside its owning chat.

![Chess opened in the real canvas editor](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/41ae590c-735e-4c0b-8a6f-7971d37636c3)

## Validation

- `npm run build-fast -- --client-only` — passed
- `npm run typecheck-client` — passed
- changed-TypeScript ESLint — passed
- `npm run test-browser-no-install -- --browser chromium --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/canvases/test/browser/editorCanvasActions.test.ts --reporter dot` — 1 passing; covers menu registration, refresh, stable-instance behavior, disabled canvases, and absence for an uninitialized chat without `canvasContext`
- `npm run test-browser-no-install -- --browser chromium --run src/vs/workbench/contrib/chat/test/browser/accessibility/chatAccessibilityHelp.test.ts --reporter dot` — 50 passing
- canvas common browser tests — 11 passing
- `npm run valid-layers-check` — passed
- `npm run check-cyclic-dependencies` — passed
- live production-path run — verified no Canvas before initialization, `Cache Stats` / `Chess` / `Token Pac-Man` after the first Agent Host response, real Chess canvas open, and one stable Chess tab after repeat selection

Findings.ConfidenceRationale: The added call, renderer/agent-host boundary, live-session materialization branch, and two downstream SDK RPCs are explicit in the traced code. The exact wall-clock cost varies by runtime and extension setup, which is reflected in medium severity rather than lower mechanism confidence.
Findings.PerformanceResource: Agent SDK runtime/session initialization, control-plane RPCs, filesystem/network I/O, CPU, and retained process/session memory
Findings.PerformanceScaling: Cost grows with the number of distinct historical chats selected or restored while canvases are enabled; the delayer coalesces bursts but cannot cancel an already-started runtime materialization, so each settled selection can resume another chat.
Findings.PerformanceOutcome: Unnecessary startup/background latency, CPU and I/O contention, and additional retained runtime memory
Findings.PreviousBehavior: Before this contribution, opening or restoring an editor-window chat hydrated its persisted session/chat state but did not request the registered canvas inventory or materialize a live Copilot chat runtime for menu data.
Findings.ChangedBehavior: The new BlockRestore contribution automatically invokes definitionProvider.listCanvases as soon as an initialized Chat view model becomes active, without waiting for the New Chat/Canvas menu to be opened.
Findings.CausalDiffEvidence: Added line 194 executes definitionProvider.listCanvases from the autorun scheduled at lines 87-113 whenever the active Chat view exposes a definition provider; the call is not conditioned on menu visibility or explicit canvas interaction.
Findings.Title: Defer canvas discovery until the restored chat runtime is needed
Findings.Impact: Restoring or selecting an idle historical Copilot chat can start/resume its agent SDK runtime and issue two control-plane RPCs merely to populate a submenu the user may never open, adding background startup CPU, filesystem/network I/O, and resident runtime memory; switching among historical chats can repeat that work for each selected chat.
Findings.Evidence: AgentHostCanvasCollection wires listCanvases to connection.listSessionCanvases. That crosses the renderer-to-agent-host boundary (localAgentHostService -> agentHostManagementService), where AgentService.listSessionCanvases calls _restoreSessionChat and the Copilot provider's _resolveSessionCanvasChat. When no live target exists, _resolveSessionCanvasChat calls _ensureResolvedChatSession, whose documented purpose is resolving a live session and whose restore path calls _resumeSession. CopilotAgentSession initialization launches the SDK session and performs customization/MCP initialization, sandbox diagnostics, canvas-extension readiness, shell setup, and usage refresh; listCanvases then performs both rpc.canvas.list and rpc.extensions.list. Persisted Chat view hydration itself uses state-manager resolveChatState, so a historical initialized chat can have canvasContext while its SDK runtime is still lazy.
Findings.Recommendation: Keep persisted/restored chats lazy: do not call listCanvases solely when canvasContext appears. Defer inventory discovery to explicit Canvas-menu interaction, or gate it on an already-live chat/runtime signal so first-message live chats still populate without resuming idle historical sessions.

RegressionFixes.Mechanism: The old fallback created a fresh empty canvas-reference array whenever the immutable chat state changed. Streaming ChatDelta actions therefore invalidated the mapped canvas observables even when the chat had no canvases.
RegressionFixes.Symptom: Agent response streaming caused avoidable per-delta canvas-array allocation, observable propagation, and CanvasService reconciliation, adding CPU and GC pressure.
RegressionFixes.FixedBehavior: The module-level emptyCanvasReferences fallback preserves reference equality while canvases are absent, preventing the canvas observable chain from rerunning for each streamed chat delta.
RegressionFixes.Evidence: ChatDelta immutably returns a new ChatState; every reconciliation fires subscription onDidChange; observableFromSubscription feeds presentationChat; mapObservableArrayCached allocates a new output array when the references input changes; and CanvasService observes context.canvases in its reconciliation autorun. The changed fallback at line 837 removes that per-delta invalidation. blame_base_line attributes the old line to bfa6dc95023e589f8bd93ab2b64b169d95e9ec98.

Scenarios.Scenario: Restore or select an initialized historical Agent Host chat in the editor window while canvases are enabled
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The Chat view model can render after persisted session/chat snapshots hydrate, but the new BlockRestore autorun immediately schedules canvas-definition discovery. The discovery is not awaited by rendering, yet cold runtime materialization competes with workbench/editor restoration for CPU and I/O.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: listSessionCanvases crosses from the renderer through LocalAgentHostService and AgentHostManagementService into AgentService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One call for the selected Chat view context initially; rapid invalidations are coalesced, but each settled distinct historical chat selection can issue another call.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Editor-window chat restoration did not list canvas definitions for a menu.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Asynchronous and not directly awaited by Chat rendering, but begins during restoration and consumes startup resources.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Resolve or resume a live Copilot SDK chat session when no live target exists.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Up to one runtime materialization per distinct cold historical chat selected; live sessions are reused.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Persisted chat hydration used AgentHostStateManager.resolveChatState and could remain lazy without a live SDK session.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Off the direct render await chain, but launches substantial initialization during restoration and retains a live runtime.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Issue rpc.canvas.list and rpc.extensions.list to the live Copilot session.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two parallel control-plane RPCs per effective inventory refresh.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Blocks only menu inventory publication, not initial chat rendering, while adding background I/O.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of distinct cold historical chats selected/restored; one Chat view context is active at a time.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: A shared ThrottledDelayer/Throttler allows one inventory request in flight and at most one coalesced queued request. Context changes cannot cancel work that has already begun.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: A warm live Copilot session avoids relaunch, but definitions are not cached in the editor contribution. Cold historical chats are materialized; stale results are dropped rather than reused.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: the automatic added call and cold _ensureResolvedChatSession branch are explicit.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Runtime launch duration and resource use vary with project customizations, MCP setup, canvas extensions, and network conditions.
Scenarios.Verdict: Reportable medium-severity eager-work regression because submenu population resumes otherwise-lazy historical runtimes without user interaction.

Scenarios.Scenario: Create a provisional chat and send the first message
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Before initialization, canvasContext/definitionProvider is absent, so no discovery runs. After session/chat state is initialized, discovery runs asynchronously and does not delay the first response path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: List registered canvases after the initialized chat context appears.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One effective call after initialization under stable state.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: No editor-window canvas inventory was requested.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Off the first-response critical path; the runtime is already live from sending the message.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Two parallel RPCs for the one refresh.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: One newly initialized active Chat view; definition count controls subsequent local filtering/sorting and menu registrations.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One request in flight through the shared throttler.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: No definition cache, but the live SDK session is warm and definitions remain displayed until an invalidation or context change.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Definition count is extension-dependent but expected to be small.
Scenarios.Verdict: No additional finding: provisional chats remain lazy and post-initialization work is bounded and off the response critical path.

Scenarios.Scenario: Canvas registry, membership, or reconnect snapshot changes for the active chat
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The subscription event is mapped to a definition invalidation; the editor contribution refreshes inventory asynchronously. Existing menu commands remain usable while the refresh runs.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Refresh listSessionCanvases after ChatCanvasesChanged, snapshot application, or relevant cancelled-refresh replay.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Bursts coalesce to one active call plus one queued call; later distinct events each refresh once.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The editor window had no definition refresh path.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Not on canvas rendering or chat streaming critical paths; affects menu freshness.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: rpc.canvas.list plus rpc.extensions.list per effective refresh.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Effective invalidation bursts rather than token count; ordinary ChatDelta actions are filtered out.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: ThrottledDelayer with a Throttler serializes calls and coalesces events arriving during one call into one follow-up.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The old successful list stays visible during same-context refreshes; failures do not replace it. Context changes clear the list. There is no negative cache.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Registry and canvas membership changes are user/extension driven and normally infrequent.
Scenarios.Verdict: No separate finding: filtering and coalescing bound the boundary fan-out, and the remaining eager cold-runtime case is covered by the reported finding.

Scenarios.Scenario: Open, refocus, or reopen a canvas from the new submenu
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Selecting a definition first scans the active canvas list for the stable instance ID. An existing sourced canvas is revealed; otherwise openSessionCanvas is awaited. Closed instances use CanvasService.reopenCanvas.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: openSessionCanvas crosses to AgentService and the Copilot provider.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: At most one call per user selection, and none when an existing sourced instance can be revealed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: This editor-window menu action did not exist.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: On the explicit open command's critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: rpc.canvas.open on the Copilot control plane.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One RPC per definition selection that lacks an existing sourced canvas.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Directly determines completion of the requested open.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Reveal/reopen a CanvasInput and potentially create its external browser view model.
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One editor operation per explicit selection, with model reuse/coalescing inside CanvasService.
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Existing canvas reveal/reopen paths performed the same editor/model work.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of canvases in the active chat for the local lookup and one selected item for boundary work.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Each command awaits one operation; CanvasService coalesces duplicate model creation and opening for the same input.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Stable instance IDs reuse an existing canvas and CanvasService reuses models or in-flight model promises by source.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Browser-view creation cost depends on canvas content and is pre-existing/user initiated.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding: expensive work is bounded to explicit user selection and existing instances avoid duplicate opens.

Scenarios.Scenario: Stream a response in a chat with no canvases
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Each ChatDelta updates ChatState, but the changed stable emptyCanvasReferences value prevents the canvas observable chain from invalidating solely because the immutable chat object changed.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Synchronous observable propagation per delta; the fixed path removes canvas-specific downstream work.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The shared empty-array identity acts as the stable empty state; actual canvas membership changes still invalidate normally.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High; the reducer, subscription event, observable adapter, mapped-array allocation, and CanvasService observer were traced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Response chunk counts vary, but the old multiplicity was one invalidation per chat action.
Scenarios.Verdict: No finding against the PR; this is a concrete repeated-work regression fix and was recorded with its introducing commit.

Scenarios.Scenario: Dispose the editor canvas action contribution or remove/change the active chat context
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Dynamic commands, menu items, widget listeners, provider listeners, and delayed work are owned by DisposableStore/DisposableMap/MutableDisposable.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of currently displayed definitions and reopenable canvases.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Disposal cancels pending delayed execution; an already-running boundary call is not cancelled but its stale result is rejected by request sequence/context checks.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: Registrations are deleted and disposed when keys disappear; context changes clear definition data. No historical command registrations are retained.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: A running stale request may finish remotely, but retained UI state is bounded.
Scenarios.Verdict: No cleanup-lifecycle finding: ownership and stale-result guards prevent unbounded listener/command retention.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over all 15 changed files and transitive canvas/session boundaries. Submitted one medium eager-work finding for automatic cold historical-runtime materialization, and recorded the stable-empty-array streaming optimization as a concrete regression fix. Other boundary calls are user initiated or coalesced, dynamic registrations are disposed, and no additional high-confidence performance regression was found.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
